research_items.source_recommendation: Price blocks at billed rate; segments/cache status, tool arguments, bytes and tokens
research_items.rationale: Record available native billed quantities and permitted segment metadata; any unobservable block allocation remains explicitly estimated. Do not invent provider per-block billing.

research_items.source_recommendation: Replace miss-rate gate with accepted-task cost and non-inferiority
research_items.rationale: Preserve quality/latency and absolute floor; cache invalidation cause remains diagnostic; stale risk reference corrected.

research_items.source_recommendation: Cache-domain identity, spine affinity and stable keys
research_items.rationale: Define qualified domain identity and supported affinity; provider key/overflow/TTL behavior requires the selected contract. No cache-residency guarantee.

research_items.source_recommendation: Security-domain isolation, lab hash and hit side channels
research_items.rationale: Handling/security-domain isolation stays mandatory. Do not select sha256_cbor or a provider isolation arrangement before the serving contract. Authorized accounting must remain available; response-cache implementation is deferred.

research_items.source_recommendation: Signed cache controls and TTL-aware exposure
research_items.rationale: Explicit TTL/key/content-reference controls bind semantic work and complete tariff; DEV-11 remains implicit-only.

research_items.source_recommendation: Prompt-layout contract/prefix-churn lint
research_items.rationale: Caller/preparer owns versioned layout; metadata lint cannot rewrite admitted work or bypass retention. No Vega edit now.

research_items.source_recommendation: Cache-state estimator for frontier/lab
research_items.rationale: Specify scope, age, uncertainty, configuration and serving evidence; defer llm-d/local estimator choice. Predicted state does not reduce a proven bound.

research_items.source_recommendation: Effort/thinking mode in configuration and acceptance
research_items.rationale: Resolve defaults and requested/effective values; configuration identity/promotion includes effort; no inherited quality from model name alone.

research_items.source_recommendation: Switching/re-warming and whole-leaf/session costs
research_items.rationale: Count additional turns, verification/recovery and switching once; avoid surcharge duplication where candidate quantities already represent rewarming.

research_items.source_recommendation: Compaction classes; never compact a compaction; batched eviction; separate purpose
research_items.disposition: DELIBERATE DEPARTURE, WITH REQUIRED HANDLING INCORPORATED
research_items.rationale: The paper prescribes never compacting a compaction. Correction 01 prohibits recursive lossy summary by default but permits only a separately reviewed exception with provenance, retrievability, handling and complete parent-task quality evidence. Reason: allow a later demonstrably valid transformation rather than claim universal impossibility. No exception is enabled. Preserve four classes, own-work attribution and versioned purpose changes. Opaque provider compaction immediately inherits the UNION of input taints/restrictions and strictest retention.

research_items.source_recommendation: Single-step replay/repricing; control forks; quantization noise
research_items.rationale: The paper lists single-step-limited replay and branched rollouts with control forks. Correction 01 keeps single-step replay/repricing as initial scope and explicitly permits a separately qualified whole-task/branched experiment with a controlled common environment, action divergence handling, independent usage, noise treatment and task acceptance. Reason: invalid observational log replay is not equivalent to an actually controlled experiment. No whole-task experiment is activated.

research_items.source_recommendation: Cascade r_f/r_d, independent false-accept audit and verifier requalification
research_items.rationale: Existing aggregate r is valid if conditional on the actual escalation mixture; record strata separately in later evaluation, rather than falsely correcting a valid identity.

research_items.source_recommendation: Sticky replans and non-security publications at boundaries
research_items.rationale: Prefer eligible incumbent placement; only an explicit qualified version policy may defer non-security publication. Never defer effective revocation or silently change current checks.

research_items.source_recommendation: Longer-lived retained segment metrics
research_items.rationale: A hash/count/aggregate is not declassified by shape. Separate approved retained schema and handling review before longer retention.

research_items.source_recommendation: Per-family pre-dispatch token estimator
research_items.disposition: SEPARATE PREDICTION FROM PROOF; IMPLEMENTATION DEFERRED
research_items.rationale: Estimator may help ranking; admission needs exact contract-qualified total billable bounds across framing, transformations and provider additions. No average ratios or untrusted estimates as hard bounds.

research_items.source_recommendation: kNN baseline and quality-first bake-off
research_items.rationale: Retain original five candidates and add simple kNN; quality eligibility first, then accepted-task cost, latency/overhead/stability. No new dependency now.

research_items.source_recommendation: Lab CPU-KV/preemption by recompute cost; revise T-33
research_items.rationale: Select serving stack and prove actual capacity release/cancel/demotion before changing physical-capacity obligations. Preserve existing T-33.

research_items.source_recommendation: Effort sweeps and same-deployment effort cascades
research_items.rationale: Requires separately approved configurations, comparable cohorts, budget and outcome criteria.

research_items.source_recommendation: Fresh manifest/prefix fork/home-cache comparison
research_items.rationale: Requires valid cohorts and handling-compatible fixtures; cache benefits never justify weaker isolation.

research_items.source_recommendation: TTL/keep-alive driven by idle-gap predictor
research_items.rationale: Needs supported controls, complete rates and evidence; keep-alive is explicitly authorized provider work, not passive telemetry.

research_items.source_recommendation: Masking windows vs summarization; shrinking tool output
research_items.rationale: Define versioned transformations and full parent-task quality/handling first; no unbound prompt edits or automatic masking safety.

research_items.source_recommendation: Single agent vs fan-out; N-sample comparator; budget return
research_items.rationale: Use comparable outcomes and attempt identities, explicit fan-out scope and unique exposure. Task completion returns only proven unused/unencumbered balance; unknown liabilities remain.
